title: RAW: separate lower-burden crossleaf music selection — full f76v.37–41 and positive/prohibitive ending fork
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_INCOMPLETE. Root prescribed a separate second selection after RAW489: complete foreign-leaf ZL paragraphs with at least30 groups and10 frozen types, ranked by exact old-position fraction then old-type fraction then ID. Among153 paragraphs on49 leaves, f76v.37–41 wins with32/55 old positions and18/38 old types. All71 meanings stay fixed;20 types at23 positions remain UNKNOWN. Whole55-group paragraph retained; no first-selection replacement or semantic test. The .41 CO_ONSET ending has a concrete positive-versus-prohibition scope fork.

specific_binding_gaps.problem: The nearest preceding UPPER_PES cannot become ENTER actor. But the following LEADER is an actually written legal actor, so this is not a forced type contradiction. A new full construction must specify the upper part's relation to ENTER(R0) at T0 without broadening ENTER.
specific_binding_gaps.prior_countercase: RAW487 D04 already combines an upper-pes first part start with the leader's ENTER using an explicit production. Its exact six-terminal construction does not automatically parse these four tokens.

specific_binding_gaps.fixed: WHEN LEADER OTHERS_SILENT NOT LEADER NEXT_FOLLOWER
specific_binding_gaps.problem: WHEN needs a stated cue and owner; .37 and .39 both write ol=X, but the full owner/scope relation must be explicit. NOT then begins a prohibition whose actor/event arguments and endpoint are unbound. OTHERS_SILENT must keep the entire pending rota set and cannot simply declare active followers silent.

ending_variants_to_keep_separate.scope: NOT in .40 ends before .41; .41 has positive polarity.
ending_variants_to_keep_separate.conditional_content: If the two ENTER terms are bound to a following singer and the leader, initial CO_ONSET asserts their first-entry times equal.
ending_variants_to_keep_separate.different_consequence: That equality conflicts with the old source cue delay for distinct leader/follower entry, conditional on those actor bindings. This is reasoning from the retained source rules, not a run or a new manuscript failure.
ending_variants_to_keep_separate.remaining_freedom: Binding both terms to the same event would yield a tautology instead, but requires a declared identity construction and does not explain the whole paragraph. No such rescue is selected in this receipt.

ending_variants_to_keep_separate.scope: NOT in .40 explicitly retains scope over .41's event relation.
ending_variants_to_keep_separate.conditional_content: With the same leader/follower argument binding, it prohibits equality of their first ENTER times.
ending_variants_to_keep_separate.different_consequence: That is compatible with the old staggered cue-entry rule while preserving all lexical denotations. Compatibility of this local candidate is not a whole-paragraph reading.
ending_variants_to_keep_separate.remaining_freedom: A complete successor still owes every word, the two WHEN cue/owner mappings, the SING process reference, all silence scopes, and one value for each repeated r/qokaiin. Scope cannot be changed after a test.
